description: This source file implements a PDF processing pipeline that detects specific logos on PDF pages, overlays new logos, and produces a modified PDF. It manages background jobs, handles file uploads, performs image processing with OpenCV, PyMuPDF, and PIL, and provides methods for job creation, status checking, previews, and downloading the processed PDF.
